svg.title: Oceanographer — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as oceanographer, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A long cable lowers an open sampling probe beneath a visibly wavy ocean surface. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
